title: campyloneurum trichiatum
intro: Campyloneurum trichiatum, commonly known as "Pride of India," is a type of fern native to the tropical forests of Central and South America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, thereby providing health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Campyloneurum trichiatum include its analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
